name: Malaga TechPark data center campus (Saltburn Holding / Benbros Energy)
developer: Saltburn Holding S.L. / Benbros Energy / Meridian Data Centers
notes: Junta de Andalucia declared the project of strategic interest (May 2026), fast-tracking EUR1.257bn investment in the Malaga TechPark expansion zone; ~100MW IT capacity with up to 150MW electrical demand, over 70,000 sqm; promoted by Saltburn Holding (Rafael Benjumea) with Benbros Energy/Meridian Data Centers.

name: Alto Infrastructure SP01 Granada AI campus
notes: SP01 at CITAI technology hub, Escuzar (Granada): groundbreaking initiated 2026, phase 1 of 10MW IT expected in service summer 2027, scaling to ~70MW IT (100MW electrical) by late 2029; about EUR700m physical infrastructure, up to EUR3bn total; closed-loop liquid cooling for AI/HPC.

name: Templus Malaga MAL01
notes: Operational Malaga colocation facility in the Guadalhorce area; expansion tripled power to about 3MW and added a new data room.

name: Templus Sevilla SEV01
notes: Operational Sevilla data center at PICA Business Park; Templus lists 370 sqm IT space and total power of 1MW after acquisition/relaunch.

name: AWS Europe (Spain) Region (eu-south-2) and Aragon expansion
developer: Amazon Web Services / Amazon Data Services Spain
notes: AWS operates its Spain cloud region in Aragon (3 AZs) and is expanding; Aragon government approved a new PIGA phase 'Expansion Region AWS en Aragon' promoted by Amazon Data Services Spain; 2026 Amazon announcement covers EUR33.7bn planned Spain data-center infrastructure investment through 2035. Region-level A evidence; exact campus sites via PIGA/BOA records.

name: Microsoft Aragon datacenter campuses (MSFT Region)
notes: Initial PIGA approval (Nov 2025) for three Microsoft campuses at La Muela, Villamayor de Gallego and Zaragoza (283.79 ha total); EUR5.356bn investment for what Microsoft calls its largest data region; first-phase construction (EUR582m) slated from 2026 pending final PIGA approval.

name: QTS Calatorao data center campus
notes: QTS official site lists its first Spain campus on a 224-hectare site in Calatorao, Zaragoza province; data-center listings report up to 300MW electrical capacity. Official page for marketed existence; local permits still needed for lifecycle.

name: Tillion Zaragoza data center
notes: Azora/Tillion announced a Zaragoza DC with initial secured capacity of 150MW, expandable to 300MW, up to EUR2bn infrastructure investment.

name: SAMCA Zaragoza data center campus
notes: SAMCA's Zaragoza campus approved as a Project of General Interest of Aragon; plans call for three data centers, initial 131MW phase and possible scale-up to 300MW.

name: Vantage Zaragoza / Villanueva de Gallego campus
developer: Vantage Data Centers / Desarrollos Ecoindustriales La Cartuja
notes: Vantage announced a EUR3.2bn hyperscale campus in Villanueva de Gallego, Zaragoza, developed over ten years in five phases on roughly 40 hectares.

name: Digital Valley Asturias - Salas campus
developer: Digital Valley Asturias / S4U with Principality of Asturias
notes: Project at Nonaya industrial park in Salas (154,584 sqm) proposes ten data center modules, 120MW final IT capacity, substation and small PV installation; EUR1.226bn announced investment; construction expected between H2 2027 and 2030.

name: Altamira Data Center campus (Stoneshield/XDC)
developer: Stoneshield Capital / XDC Properties; Sener/Quark design
notes: Altamira project near Santander (Marina de Cudeyo, Penagos 220kV substation): 500MW campus in three phases; first 100MW phase set to start work January 2026 for 2032 launch; EUR3.6bn investment with Cantabria government. Sener project page confirms 500MW capacity.

name: Templus Ceuta CEU01
notes: First Ceuta data center, located in the port at Puntilla dock (Muelle de la Puntilla); 2,500 sqm, initial 1.2MW, planned expansion to 2.4MW; ground broken Nov 2025, expected operational H1 2026; Tier III facility connecting Europe and Africa via Dos Continentes cables.

name: DC Mudarra Torrelobaton data center
notes: Planned Torrelobaton, Valladolid campus (CPD San Lorenzo) would include two buildings of up to 80MW IT each for 160MW total and EUR1.6bn-EUR2bn investment; environmental authorization request in public information period (2026); near La Mudarra substation and wind park.

name: Social Security CPD Soria
developer: Spain Ministry of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration
notes: Public-sector data processing center in Los Royales, Soria; official Social Security notice covered the construction license and DCD reported the project above 80 percent complete in 2026, targeted operational late 2026.

name: Meta Talavera de la Reina Data Center Campus
notes: Castilla-La Mancha territorial planning portal lists the Meta Data Center Campus as Proyecto de Singular Interes (PSI); project in Torrehierro industrial estate phase 2, Talavera de la Reina (191 ha, ~102 ha for data centers); Junta approved the reparcelacion project Aug 2026; secondary sources report phased buildout toward 2030 and about 248MW.

name: Nostrum GUA1 Guadalajara data center
developer: Nostrum Data Centers / Ingenostrum; IDOM design
notes: Nostrum GUA1 in Guadalajara has two hectares of land and 40MWe of guaranteed power; construction planned late 2026, operation estimated during 2028.

name: DC Malpica AI - Mora, Toledo
developer: EdgeMode / BlackBerry AIF / Mora Town Council partners
notes: Mora/Toledo AI data center campus proposal presented to Castilla-La Mancha government; developers describe EUR3bn, 300MW project seeking priority-project status; MOU-stage, no official PSI approval found.

name: Fortinet Guadalajara data center
notes: Fortinet announced opening its first Spain data center in Guadalajara, Castilla-La Mancha, to support European service delivery and cybersecurity services; capacity not disclosed.

name: Grupo Aire OASIX Toledo data center
notes: Operational OASIX Toledo data center listed as opened in 2022, around 800 sqm with more than 54 racks; directory-level evidence, included as a smaller regional facility.

name: D-ALiX Tenerife data center (Granadilla)
notes: D-ALiX at Granadilla de Abona, Tenerife is an operational neutral access point, submarine cable station and data center; grid access granted by Red Electrica in 2011; third-party specs list 5MW and 2,000 sqm.

name: Grupo Aire OASIX Las Palmas data center
notes: Carrier-neutral Las Palmas de Gran Canaria facility at Av. Juan XXIII 44, operational since 2010, about 235 sqm and more than 50 racks for colocation/cloud/interconnection.

name: Telefonica Tech VDC node in Tenerife data center
notes: Telefonica Tech deployed a Virtual Data Center node in the Tenerife data center to serve Canary Islands enterprises and public administrations with local cloud services; hosted capability rather than a standalone new facility.

name: Ark Data Centres Barcelona / La Maquinista
notes: Ark's first Spain development in Barcelona's La Maquinista area (Sant Andreu district): about 30,000 sqm of industrial land acquired with legal/transactional confirmation May 2026, up to 45MW IT capacity and over EUR600m investment; Generalitat (Accio) and Barcelona City accompany the project.

name: Equinix BA2 Barcelona IBX
notes: Operational BA2 IBX in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat adjacent to BA1; Equinix lists 27,147 sq ft and 100 percent renewable energy coverage; DCD reported 3.4MW capacity.

name: Templus Barcelona BCN01 / bitNAP
notes: Templus acquired bitNAP's Barcelona data center in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat; facility spans more than 3,000 sqm and has 1.7MW capacity, with roadmap to double IT capacity.

name: Nostrum Evergreen / BAZ-01 Badajoz data center
developer: Nostrum Data Centers / Ingenostrum; AECOM design/works direction
notes: Nostrum Evergreen/BAZ-01 at Badajoz logistics platform planned in phases from 2026; AECOM says first phase is 150MWe and second phase reaches 300MWe, design scalable to 500MWe; over EUR1.9bn investment.

name: Ingenostrum CC Green Caceres data center
notes: Early Extremadura hyperscale project in Caceres/Las Capellanias eco-park; DCD reported a 150MW carbon-neutral data center in 2021; later listings show the CC Green/Nostrum Caceres campus seeking larger grid capacity; stale announcement, no construction evidence found.

name: Merlin Properties / Edged Extremadura AI campuses
developer: Merlin Properties / Edged Energy / Government of Extremadura
notes: Merlin/Edged and Extremadura government signed to promote two large AI data center campuses using waterless cooling and green energy; secondary reporting locates them around Navalmoral de la Mata and Valdecaballeros; site-level permits not yet public.

name: Galicia Green Data Center (GAL1)
notes: GAL1 in Galicia has strategic-project status, construction license, four hectares of secured land and 25MWe granted power; construction scheduled Q2 2026, operation targeted Q3 2027. Earlier reporting described the project as 15MW carbon-neutral.

name: CESGA new datacenter (A Sionlla, Santiago)
developer: CESGA / Xunta de Galicia; Copasa; Dominion
notes: New CESGA datacenter at A Sionlla industrial park, Santiago de Compostela for Finisterrae IV, storage and quantum computing; construction started Nov 2025, declared strategic public-research project by Xunta in Oct 2025; Dominion case study states the center is prepared for IT loads up to 3.2MW.

name: Xunta de Galicia public-sector CPD at A Sionlla
notes: Regional government project for a new CPD in A Sionlla business park, Santiago de Compostela, over 8,000-10,000 sqm as central infrastructure for the autonomous-government cloud strategy; anteproyecto presented Nov 2021 with completion originally targeted 2025; may overlap with CESGA datacenter construction in the same park - treat status carefully.

name: Infotelecom Palma / Son Castello data center
notes: Infotelecom says its new Palma data center in Son Castello is live, connected with its Ciutadella and Mao centers, and includes rooftop solar covering up to 80% of the center's electricity consumption.

name: Vodafone Marratxi data center
notes: Marratxi municipal announcement says Vodafone selected the municipality for a new data center with Tier-3-equivalent certifications and redundant 10Gbps circuits, hosting more than 500 Juniper servers; Data Center Market reports a 140 sqm facility opened in Marratxi for private cloud services.

name: IslaLink Palma/Mallorca cable landing data center
notes: IslaLink offers colocation services from its Palma de Mallorca cable landing station/data center, part of its Balearic connectivity infrastructure.

name: Casiopeia / Grupo Fotones Murcia data center campus
notes: Casiopea project near Espinardo university campus (Murcia) would deploy up to 140MW in two phases (initial capacity 78MW per Grupo Fotones), EUR1.15bn; construction potentially starting late 2027 with completion during 2028.

name: Cartagena Data Green
notes: Proposed Valle de Escombreras data center using cold from Enagas LNG regasification plant for high-density/AI workloads; civil works and thermal connection targeted Q4 2026, testing around mid-2028 and commercial launch H1 2029; capacity not yet public.

name: Kumo/Murcia Data Center
notes: Kumo lists offices/data center presence in Murcia and Valencia; Uptime Institute certification page identifies Kumo/Murcia Data Center in Murcia, Spain.

name: ITRES Murcia data center
notes: ITRES operates a Murcia-area CPD in Alcantarilla with 700 sqm of facilities, 33 racks installed, 88-rack capacity, redundant power, cooling and fiber interconnection to Valencia and Madrid.

name: Microsoft Azure Spain Central region
notes: Microsoft's first Spain cloud region (Spain Central) opened June 2024 in the Community of Madrid with three Availability Zones; region-level A evidence for existence, exact facility sites not publicly mapped.

name: Google Cloud Madrid region (europe-southwest1)
notes: Google Cloud Madrid region europe-southwest1 opened in 2022, built with Telefonica; A for logical region existence, C for exact facility inference.

name: Madrid Sur (Echelon Iberdrola Digital Infra)
notes: Iberdrola describes Madrid Sur as its first DPC/data center JV project, with 144MW processing capacity, 230MW electrical connection and a 160,000 sqm complex in the Madrid region; official page but project status/site permits to be confirmed locally.

name: Nabiax Alcala de Henares Data Center Campus
notes: Nabiax Alcala campus near Madrid-Barajas: two phases built delivering ~22MW IT power (after expansion from 15.1MW), scalable to 100MW maximum IT power; ADC2 expansion (EUR40m) built by Ferrovial; own electrical substation.

name: Iron Mountain Madrid campus / MAD-1
notes: Iron Mountain lists MAD-1 at Calle Mar Egeo 4, San Fernando de Henares, with 3MW current capacity and up to 79MW planned across a 60,000 sqm campus.

name: DATA4 Madrid MAD02 San Agustin del Guadalix campus
notes: DATA4's second Madrid campus in San Agustin del Guadalix: over 16,000 sqm IT space across four buildings, 80MW total power (12MW IT first phase per Invest in Spain 2023); DATA4 lists MAD02 as Madrid campus; later phase status to be confirmed in municipal records.

name: Digital Realty MAD5
notes: Digital Realty's fifth Madrid data center, MAD5, in the MaDBit/Julian Camarillo area with 20-24MW capacity and about EUR300m investment; land acquisition completed.

name: Equinix MD6 / MD3x Madrid (Alcobendas)
notes: Equinix MD6 in Alcobendas is a leased IBX portion of the MD3x/xScale facility, 1,466 sqm, 4.8MW and 600 racks; MD3x is Equinix's first xScale data center in Madrid.

name: Prime Data Centers MAD01 Alcobendas
notes: Prime lists its Madrid campus in Alcobendas as a development/available hyperscale facility with 40MW critical IT load across 25,810 sqm and on-site Iberdrola substation.

name: Ferrovial MAD01 Valdelacasa campus
notes: DCD reports Ferrovial's phased Madrid campus in Valdelacasa starts with MAD01, a 60MW total-capacity facility including 40MW IT load; full campus investment around EUR1bn.

name: Campus Data Navarra
developer: Grupo VDR; Quark/Sener technical design; Colliers
notes: Campus Data Navarra at Gazolaz industrial estate, Cendea de Cizur, 7km from Pamplona: EUR3.3bn investment, 300MW projected installed capacity, construction/operation phases scheduled 2027-2029; planning approval anticipated late 2025-early 2026.

name: ADI Data Center Euskadi - Bizkaia (Abanto-Zierbena)
developer: Atlantic Data Infrastructure (Euskaltel, Dominion, Teknei, Basque Government, Kutxabank, Iberdrola, Mondragon)
notes: ADI Bizkaia facility at Ezkerraldea-Meatzaldea/Biscay Science and Technology Park: commissioned in two 1MW phases with Uptime Tier IV fault-tolerance; first phase entered operation Q1 2025 per Garaia park announcement.

name: ADI Data Center Euskadi - Gipuzkoa / Garaia Technology Park
notes: Second ADI building in Garaia Technology Park, Arrasate-Mondragon, Gipuzkoa: over 5,000 sqm, up to 3MW of IT equipment in two rooms fitted out in phases; construction started Dec 2024.

name: Sarenet Derio data center
notes: Sarenet's Derio/Zamudio communications-hub facility in Bizkaia: EUR20m, 1,000 sqm data center with 3MW installed electrical capacity and up to 340 racks, inaugurated 2026.

name: Solaria Basque Country data center grid connection
notes: Solaria announced Red Electrica feasibility confirmation for 225MW demand to supply DPC/data centers in the Basque Country; CNMV filing records the related connection notice. Grid-connection evidence for a pipeline; no facility site announced.

name: Arsys Logrono data center
notes: Arsys flagship data center in Logrono (Portalada), operational since 2009; Tier III certification obtained (Uptime Institute record); manages over 10,000 logical servers; secondary reviews cite 6MW power capacity; first-round discovery reported capacity for up to 15,000 servers in four 250 sqm data rooms.

name: NXN-VLC1 Valencia (Vara de Quart)
developer: NXN Datacenters / Nethits Telecom / Adequita Capital
notes: NXN-VLC1 in Vara de Quart industrial park, Valencia: EUR60m project, up to 6MW IT across 6,500 sqm (1,500 sqm IT space), 100% renewable, zero water consumption; green light received March 2025, expected operational 2026.

name: Kumo Valencia / Paterna Tier IV data center
notes: Kumo lists a Valencia office/data-center address in Paterna and Uptime-grade certifications; DataCenterMap describes the Paterna site as a Tier IV data center with over EUR50m investment.

name: Valencia Digital Port Connect (VDPC) Sagunto data center
developer: Valencia Digital Port Connect / Pygmalion Group
notes: Pygmalion describes a 332,000 sqm strategic digital-infrastructure project aligned with Valencian digitalization strategy; DataCenterMap lists VDPC in Sagunto as supporting subsea cable connectivity and advanced computing for the Barracuda Genoa-Spain cable; directory-level evidence only.

name: IslaLink Valencia/FSL data center and cable landing colocation
notes: IslaLink offers colocation from cable landing stations including Valencia/FSL; DCD notes IslaLink also offers colocation from its Mallorca and Valencia cable landing stations.
